title: model.usage payload
description: Token-usage evidence for a model call. v1 is the legacy unattributed sample; v2 attributes one normalized cumulative sample to a call_id (OBS-02/D2). Optional buckets stay absent when the provider reports nothing — scalar zero is never fabricated for unknown presence.

reasoning_tokens.description: Completion-token subset spent on reasoning; omitted when unreported or zero.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt-token prefix served from the provider cache (prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens); omitted when unreported or zero.

cache_write_tokens.description: Provider-reported cache creation subset of prompt tokens; omitted when unreported.

call_id.description: Observed call this sample belongs to (v2).

usage_kind.description: v2 samples are normalized cumulative counters, not per-chunk deltas.

normalization_partial.description: True when provider counters contradicted the pinned monotonic merge; totals are provisional, never claimed complete (v2).

settlement.description: True on the single mandatory End sample; exempt from the MaxEvents budget like run terminals (v2).
